patthana22.31:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ no saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika noganthagocchakaduke sanidassanattika ganthagocchakadukaṃ
patthana22.31:2.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ no ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika nooghagocchakaduke sanidassanattika oghagocchakadukaṃ
patthana22.31:3.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ no oghaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho ogho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana22.31:4.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika noyogagocchakaduke sanidassanattika yogagocchakadukaṃ
patthana22.31:5.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ no yogaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho yogo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana22.31:6.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika nonīvaraṇagocchakaduke sanidassanattika nīvaraṇagocchakadukaṃ
patthana22.31:7.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ no nīvaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho nīvaraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana22.31:8.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika noparāmāsagocchakaduke sanidassanattika parāmāsagocchakadukaṃ
patthana22.31:9.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ no parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho parāmāso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana22.31:10.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika nasārammaṇaduke sanidassanattika sārammaṇadukaṃ
